Apps.Name: app1 production data (read-only)
Apps.Description: Read-only access to the masked views of app1 on the PostgreSQL and MariaDB read replicas, through OpenBao (database/creds/app1-pg-ro, database/creds/app1-maria-ro).

Apps.Name: app1 production data (WRITE, PostgreSQL primary)
Apps.Description: Break-glass data fix on the app1 PostgreSQL primary: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE on public.customers and public.orders (unmasked), through OpenBao (database/creds/app1-pg-rw, 30-minute credentials). Every statement and every changed row is audited. Prefer a reviewed migration. Approved by app1-write-approvers.
